comments.body: We renewed on February 1 but we are moving routing in-house. Please cancel and refund. Our Brisklane terms allow refunds within 60 days.
Brisklane legacy customer (migration addendum 2025-07-01, Brisklane terms until 2027-01-31). Day 32 after renewal. Escalated to Tomás Herrera (RevOps) per the new approval flow.
Hi Tom, Tomás Herrera from RevOps approved a full refund under your Brisklane terms. Your subscription is cancelled and you will receive the refund within 10 business days.
